# U7Y Academic Journal

> > U7Y Academic Journal (ISSN 3042-4399) is an open-access, peer-reviewed scholarly publication focusing on interdisciplinary research in business, technology, society, and digital transformation.

Published by VBNN Smart Education Group and indexed in Dimensions (Digital Science), U7Y Journal operates under CC BY 4.0 licensing and follows COPE publication ethics guidelines. The journal publishes research articles spanning critical sociology, digital capitalism, organizational management, e-business, AI impacts, and contemporary socio-economic phenomena.

## Key Topics

- Open-access publishing
- Peer review and academic publishing
- CC BY 4.0 licensing
- ISSN 3042-4399
- COPE publication ethics
- Digital transformation and e-business
- Critical sociology of technology
- AI and digital capitalism
- Organizational management evolution
- Platform economics and social media
- Business education and higher education
- Research excellence and scholarly communication
- DOI and researcher identifiers (ORCID, Scopus)
- VBNN Smart Education Group
- Dimensions indexing

## Digital Technology & AI Research

- [Beyond ChatGPT: Rethinking the History and Sociology of Artificial Intelligence](https://www.u7y.com/articles/beyond-chatgpt-rethinking-the-history-and-sociology-of-artificial-intelligence): Historical and sociological analysis of AI beyond ChatGPT
- [Framing the Future: The Impact of AI-Generated Video on Major Film Creators](https://www.u7y.com/articles/framing-the-future-the-impact-of-ai-generated-video-on-major-film-creators): AI-generated video impact on film production and creators
- [The Evolution and Impact of E-Business in the Modern Economy](https://www.u7y.com/articles/the-evolution-and-impact-of-e-business-in-the-modern-economy): Academic article on e-business evolution and economic impact

## Platform Economics & Digital Capitalism

- [From Billion-Dollar Boom to Multi-Million Bust: A Critical Sociology of Tumblr's Valuation Collapse (2013–2019)](https://www.u7y.com/articles/from-billion-dollar-boom-to-multi-million-bust-a-critical-sociology-of-tumblr-s-valuation-collapse): Critical sociology analysis of Tumblr's valuation collapse (2013-2019)
- [The Cryptoqueen in Context: OneCoin, Transnational Fraud, and the Sociology of Trust in Digital Capitalism](https://www.u7y.com/articles/the-cryptoqueen-in-context-onecoin-transnational-fraud-and-the-sociology-of-trust-in-digital-capi): OneCoin fraud analysis through sociology of trust in digital capitalism

## Business & Higher Education

- [The History of Business Education: Evolution and Impact](https://www.u7y.com/articles/the-history-of-business-education-evolution-and-impact): Historical analysis of business education development and impact
- [NGOs, Capital, and the Architecture of Partnership: How Civil Society Strengthens Sustainable Higher Education — The Case of the European Council of Leading Business Schools (ECLBS)](https://www.u7y.com/articles/ngos-capital-and-the-architecture-of-partnership-how-civil-society-strengthens-sustainable-higher): ECLBS case study on NGO partnerships in sustainable higher education

## Organizational Management & Society

- [The Evolving Role of the Secretary in Contemporary Organizations: Strategic Coordination, Digital Governance, and Executive Support](https://www.u7y.com/articles/the-role-of-the-secretary-an-academic-research): Research on secretary role evolution in modern organizational management
- [The Evolving Role of Secretaries and Office Management in Modern Organizations](https://www.u7y.com/articles/the-evolving-role-of-secretaries-and-office-management-in-modern-organizations): Study on secretarial and office management evolution in workplaces
- [Reclaiming Silence: The Rise and Impacts of Digital Detox Tourism in 2025](https://www.u7y.com/articles/reclaiming-silence-the-rise-and-impacts-of-digital-detox-tourism-in-2025): Analysis of digital detox tourism trends and wellness travel in 2025
- [Membership Without the Ballot? Economic and Institutional Implications of the EU's Emerging Non-Voting Entry Model](https://www.u7y.com/articles/membership-without-the-ballot-economic-and-institutional-implications-of-the-eu-s-emerging-non-voti): EU non-voting membership model: economic and institutional implications
